$comment: SPEC 06 §7.2 / SPEC 05 §4.1 — the downloadable speech-model catalogue. Sizes are the published whisper.cpp GGML sizes; RAM guidance is the memory the model needs to run comfortably on CPU. Nothing here claims a benchmark result: `testedForMoments` stays null until docs/verification.md exists.

models.label: Tiny
models.notes: Quick drafts and rough timing. Not recommended for captions you will publish.

models.label: Tiny (English)
models.notes: Slightly more accurate than Tiny for English.

models.label: Base
models.notes: Small and quick; good for searching footage.

models.label: Small
models.notes: The balance most people want for captions.

models.label: Medium
models.notes: Noticeably slower; better with accents and noise.

models.label: Large v3 Turbo
models.notes: Large-model accuracy at a much lower cost than Large v3.

models.label: Large v3
models.notes: Best accuracy, slowest on CPU. Only worth it for difficult audio.
